name: Icon pop
what: One icon pops in and keeps pulsing: an app-style tile with letters (like an editing app's icon), a red warning sign that shakes, or a round symbol - a ring goes out and the glow breathes on every pulse.

learned_from.what: an app tile popping with a glow
an app tile popping and pulsing
a red warning sign popping and shaking

motion: pops to 1.15 in 8 f, settles back.out 10 f with a glow swell; the warning shakes; a pulse every 36 f
